info.name: Returns the configuration details necessary for Gremlin to access GCP resources.

params.name: teamId
params.description: Required when using company session token.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides the necessary details a customer needs in order to configure their GCP project so that Gremlin can access it.

Requires the privilege [`MINIMUM_TEAM_PRIVILEGES`](https://www.gremlin.com/docs/user-management/access-control/#privileges)
